notes.title: Tako no Himitsu new trailer update!
notes.notes:
Bonsoir,

I hope you've all been doing well. We are hard at work with the team on the development of Tako no Himitsu: Ocean of Secrets. We are almost done with the first act of the game, there is still a lot of content to be made, but we still wanted to give you a new glimpse of our game world. We also have a lot of progress on the soundtrack, including a new battle track by Motoi Sakuraba, the composer behind Golden Sun, the Tales of series, Dark Soul and Star Ocean!

[previewyoutube=VZdkMaBJuNw;full][/previewyoutube]

This trailer was part of two indie game showcases, so please go check the other games and wishlist them as well:

- AG French Direct
[previewyoutube=_mJfGPdssCU;full][/previewyoutube]

- Indie Quest
[previewyoutube=QAanpHTfrAw;full][/previewyoutube]

Since our last update, we also worked and released an other game, Wednesdays, so please check it out: store.steampowered.com/app/2747770/Wednesdays/

We are now back working full time on Tako No Himitsu, we are so happy to see the game world come to life, and we can't wait for all of you to experience it!
